profile.name: Kamal Raj Sekar
profile.tagline: AI Consultant · Tech Coach · Author · Speaker
profile.intro: I help technology leaders and their teams to put AI to work across the engineering process, make their operations agentic, and ship quality software, backed by proven engineering practices.

summary:
I help your organisations leverage AI throughout the engineering processes wherever applicable, make your organization's operations agentic, and ship quality software using proven engineering practices and modern AI tools. 

For 17+ years I've coached engineering teams on the practices - TDD, BDD, pair programming, refactoring, and continuous delivery. AI writes code quickly but can't tell you whether it's right, so the teams getting real value from it are the ones who already knew how to answer that question.

I've co-created two AI products, written three books on TDD and AI-assisted development, co-authored 'Agentic Code Surgery for Brownfield Systems' (Zenodo, 2026), and published the white paper 'Real Productivity, Rare Pushbacks'.

experience.details:
★ Provide Technical Coaching and AI Consulting to startups and Fortune 500 companies, helping teams adopt modern engineering practices and AI-augmented workflows.

★ Deliver custom AI workshops tailored to clients' business context, use cases, and tech stacks.

★ Authored the whitepaper 'Real Productivity, Rare Pushbacks' on integrating AI agents into product development.

★ Co-authored the research paper 'Agentic Code Surgery for Brownfield Systems' (Zenodo, 2026) - a seven-agent workflow that disciplines AI assistants with characterization tests before touching brownfield code.

★ Built MVPs for two AI SaaS products:
- **FaceQuest** – AI-powered facial recognition platform (1:1 verification & 1:N search)
- **Notesally** – AI assistant for sales productivity and CRM data quality

books.title: Test-First Copilot - Greenfield Edition (.NET and React)
books.authors: Kamal Raj Sekar, Kiran Kashyap, Vivek Ganesan
books.description: How to build a greenfield app with GitHub Copilot without letting the tests slide. Written with Kiran and Vivek after we kept seeing teams ship fast and regret it later.

books.title: TDD for C# and .Net Core
books.description: Test-driven development for .NET Core and microservices, from the first failing test through to the patterns you need on a real service.

books.title: TDD for Angular
books.description: A starting point for Angular developers who have never written a test first. Small steps, working examples, no assumed background.

publications.title: Agentic Code Surgery for Brownfield Systems
publications.authors: Vivek Ganesan, Kiran Kashyap, Kamal Raj Sekar
publications.description: Proposes a seven-agent workflow - Plan, Map, Break, Cover, Implement, Refactor, Finish - that forces an AI assistant to characterize existing behavior with tests before touching code. Applied to a real brownfield codebase, this workflow produced 43 new passing tests (raising statement coverage from 0.85% to 16.78%) vs. zero new tests with a regular approach, and avoided all critical and major bugs the regular approach introduced.
publications.summary: Seven agents (Plan, Map, Break, Cover, Implement, Refactor, Finish) that make an AI assistant write characterization tests before it touches your code.

publications.title: Real Productivity, Rare Pushbacks
publications.description: What we learned putting AI agents into real product teams: where they genuinely helped, where people pushed back, and what we would do differently.

posts.title: An attempt to explain how AI actually learns — without a single complex equation!

posts.title: Are your org’s secrets leaking through AI tools?
posts.summary: A supply chain attack sounds like something that happens to someone else. If anyone on your team uses an AI coding agent, your secrets are in the blast radius.
